jobs.title: LPN Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) Behavioral Health Care Manager
jobs.description_text: LPN Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) Behavioral Health Care Manager Location: Hollywood, FL (In Office) Schedule: Full-Time Salary: $64,000 - $70,000 per year About Infinite Medical P.C. Infinite Medical P.C. is a nationwide network of advanced practice providers and specialty clinicians committed to delivering high-quality, proactive care to residents of skilled nursing and long-term care facilities. Through our partnership with MedElite Healthcare Management Group, we provide coordinated, patient-centered services designed to improve clinical outcomes and address the unique medical and behavioral health needs of residents. Together, we promote collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement in senior care. Position Summary Infinite Medical P.C. is seeking a dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Behavioral Health Care Manager within our Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) program. This is an in-office, non-face-to-face care management position . The LPN Behavioral Health Care Manager remotely supports residents in skilled nursing and long-term care facilities through medical record review, behavioral health screening, care planning, registry management, care-team collaboration, and psychiatric case consultation. The Behavioral Health Care Manager works as part of an integrated care team that includes the treating medical provider, psychiatric consultant, clinical leadership, facility staff, and other members of the patient’s care team. Position Overview Infinite Medical P.C. is seeking an on-site, detail-oriented Licensed Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Nursing Care Coordinator. Operating strategically in an administrative role, you will review and verify chart documentation to ensure compliance and support seamless continuity of care for our patient population. Key Responsibilities Compliance & Records Review : Evaluate patient records and Review Visit Logs (RVLs) to ensure clinical accuracy and strict adherence to CMS and internal operational guidelines. Quality Assurance : Identify documentation discrepancies, generate clinical corrections, and submit suggestions for resolution. Cross-Functional Communication : Coordinate with HR, Operations, and Clinical teams to resolve inquiries and escalate technical issues promptly. Professional Development : Participate in mandatory operational and educational meetings, complete post-training surveys, and cross-train in expanding care management verticals. Systems Utilization : Maintain proficiency across primary digital platforms, including Emsow, PointClickCare, Sigma/Matrix, Reliable/Visual, Yardi-One and Google Workspace.
